title: bn254-gt-dlp special extended tower number field sieve (6,2) over Q(zeta_7)

claims.statement: For the full protected BN254 target and uniform z=g^x, the special extended tower number field sieve of proof.md (tower F_p[y]/(Phi_7) of degree 6, f = eps^4 P(x^2/eps) of degree 8 and g = x^2 - u*eps with eps = 2+y, smoothness bound 2^54 on both sides, block Wiedemann over Z/r, ECM boot with bound 2^200 and a four-level special-q descent with bounded retries) returns x with g^x=z with success probability at least 0.50 (the ledger derives 0.92) over uniform challenges and fresh coins under the disclosed heuristics H1-H8, at total classical work at most 2^108.000000 reference units (20,000 scalar AArch64 instruction equivalents per unit) on every run and at most 2^62 bytes of peak total storage. Every loop, candidate budget, ECM curve count and descent retry is a fixed integer cap, so the work bound holds on every run; each cap's failure probability is charged into the success budget (no search repeats until success). The ledger of machine.md (relation collection, survivor factorisation, Schirokauer maps, linear algebra, two boots, descent, verification and output, all without amortisation over future targets) is recomputed from the protected constants and the shipped measurements by experiment.py, whose rounded-up total is asserted to be at most the claimed bound. No production-scale attack was executed; the heuristics, their measured support at the stated scales and their limits are explained in proof.md.

experiments.purpose: Verify the tower, twist and common root at full size; re-verify a reviewer-chosen subset of the shipped measurements (exact norms of production cells with unit multiplicities, one production special-q lattice sample by seed, one toy-scale region with its realised relations and a replay of its first 1200 cells, one ECM trial set); recompute all summary statistics and the complete ledger from the protected constants; assert the rounded-up score. This supports the stated heuristics at their stated scales only and does not run a production sieve or prove production success.
